title: Signal: Dependency resolved through the workspace protocol
scope: A package.json file that declares a `workspace:` specifier, which resolves a sibling workspace instead of a registry version.
limitations: It matches a `workspace:` specifier, which resolves a sibling workspace instead of a registry version in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A private root manifest that is never published is still reported; the rule reads the manifest, not the publish state.
